Positioned within easy reach of the new Midland Metropolitan University Hospital, this property sits in the vibrant heart of Edgbaston. A short walk takes you to local amenities.

Each of the seven bedrooms comfortably accommodates a double bed, wardrobe and desk. Two bedrooms benefit from an en-suite shower room. All bedrooms are of a similar size for fairness.

A fully equipped kitchen includes sleek fittings, a breakfast bar, and ample storage. The open-plan kitchen-diner creates a sociable cooking space. A large separate lounge provides additional communal living space.

The property has been designed to create a welcoming, homely atmosphere with plenty of natural daylight.

A large private rear garden provides outdoor space for warmer months. Secure bike storage is available for all tenants.

Where bills are included: Gas, electricity, water, TV licence, fibre broadband where possible (limited by a fair usage policy).
